slides.texte_overlay:
Why every man should
write handwritten letters
A letter shows real effort. In a world of quick messages, taking the time to write by hand makes people feel truly valued.
People keep letters for years. A text disappears in the chat. A letter ends up in a drawer and gets read again and again.
Writing by hand slows your thinking. You choose words more carefully and often say things you'd never say in a message.
It's perfect for thank-yous. After a dinner, an interview, a favour. A short handwritten note is remembered for a long time.
Before: I struggled to find the right words. After: five minutes a day of history, art or science, and my writing feels richer.
slides.texte_sophia: Before: I struggled to find the right words. After: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. My writing feels richer.

slides.texte_overlay: Write to your grandparents or parents. They'll treasure it more than any gift. It's a simple way to say what usually goes unsaid.
Keep it short and honest. Three sentences that come from the heart are better than a perfect page. Start this week with one card.
